packageRules.description: VanillaBP and the adapters follow the framework, not Renovate: their versions are bumped when a release is cut, and while they are snapshots there is nothing to look up.

The Process-Engine-API is the contract this adapter is compiled against, and the README names the range it was tested against. A new minor can change that contract, so it comes as a PR to look at and to carry into the README, not as an automerge.
